# Prevent recovered drafts from returning during repeated browser history traversal

## What & Why
A draft that has been reopened should be cleared from recovery state. Repeated browser back and forward navigation should not make the old recovery notice reappear or allow the same draft to be reopened twice.

## Done looks like
- Recovering a draft after browser history navigation removes its notice.
- Repeated back and forward navigation does not restore the old notice.
- The reopened form retains its values until the user saves or explicitly cancels it.
